# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, keep discussions on topic, and do not harass anyone.
Personal attacks, discriminatory language and publishing others' private information are not tolerated.

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainers privately through the contact details on their GitHub profiles.
All reports are reviewed and handled confidentially. Maintainers may remove, edit or reject comments, commits,
issues and other contributions that do not follow this code, and may ban contributors who repeatedly violate it.
